reviews.text:
Bugs and Issues. This app recently stopped working. Whenever I press “Add food” it just hangs and does nothing.
The entire point of the app is to log food and I can’t do that.

Good, but is desperate for users to buy premium. I found this app quite helpful to begin my fitness journey, but after using it for months I’ve grown quite tired and annoyed of this app. The nutritional values are almost always slightly wrong, and if i could add my own details or edit them itd be great! But no, not unless you pay $20 for a membership, i find this completely ridiculous, my gym membership costs $15 a month why in the hell would i pay even more just to get my nutritional values correct? Deleting this and using another app.

Love but not everything works. This app helps me tremendously and I love the functionality of it. However I noticed that the voice function where you speak what you have eaten doesn’t work and importing recipes also. I would love to continue to pay for these features however since they don’t work I guess I will go back to the free version 😭

Prioritized customer service?!. There’s been a glitch in my account and I’ve been unable to get a hold of customer service outside of the AI service. That does absolutely nothing to help. Getting in contact with a human for customer service seems to be a total crapshoot.

Update screws things up as usual.. EVERY time there is an update to supposedly “improve” an app that is working fine, the geniuses at MyfitnessPal manage to screw it up. So now it won’t load on my iPad. And of course they never think it’s their problem. Well, until they eventually manage to fix it.

Please change the interface back. This app has been great but I have to leave this here for them to change the interface back. It’s all over the place, harder to see all your numbers together. Clicking way more buttons then need be to access your tracking for the day. Please, it was perfect before and it’s become like the Apple photos updates, unnecessary change and not for the better.
Barcode scanner not free. Barcode scanner is premium feature, but free on other apps
User Friendly. I’ve been enjoying this app and its ease of use! It fully integrates with my training app and allows my fitness trainer to provide regular feedback !
Syncing issues.. I got the app for it to sync with Garmin and it doesn't seem to like to sync to anything. This is my second time re-installing the app.

New notifications. The new notification as passive aggressive trash. They are not funny. The product manager who oversaw the development and the director who approved it should both be fired. Uninstalled.
MFP. MyFitnessPal makes calorie tracking and healthy eating easy and effective.
Awful and misses the mark in so many ways. Awful and misses the mark in so many ways. This version is the worst

HORRIBLE April 2026 Update!!. June update: many complaints from users later. Still takes 3 times longer to do things Nothing useful on fixes. Still regret not checking my renewal date. 
April: NOT time saving. The meals list is gone. Now extra clicks to get to my diary, meals and the food list. Not helpful at all. Give us the option if we want the stupid bullet points or if we want the full list. At least do that. The macro information has changed again not helpful. I absolutely hate the date setup on this update. Itbhers in the way and of course extra taps. I want to see day of week and date at the same time that we previously had. Days of week with checkmarks not helpful. New set up takes up way too much space so more scrolling. Seeing the meal list all at once much easier. So far more work than app used to be. You asked for feedback about updating the web version, which I also use, great. You Are completely oblivious to getting feedback on the app, you continually fix things that are not broken. This app is now more time-consuming to use. not a happy camper and I pay extra for this. 

Programmers, what you think may be a great awesome idea in your little technical world not always translated to the users and how we use it. You need to keep that in mind. Just ‘cause you’re bored doesn’t mean you need to fix something that wasn’t broken.

Forced to switch to another app. I signed up for the premium features. The same day my bank account was charged the annual fee, that same day I was kicked out of the app and unable to get back in. I tried resetting my password, reaching out to support THREE times, nothing, I finally gave up, cancelled my subscription and paid for another tracker app (Cal AI). Being annoyed/frustrated that I lost ALL my tracking data and had to start over. Never in my life have I experienced this with any other app. Horrible.

Has only gotten worse over a decade of development. I have been using this app for a LONG time, and I can honestly say that it’s only become LESS useful over it’s lifetime, and any improvements made have been completely negated by intrusive ads and gating actually good features behind the premium version. The new UI redesign is absolutely atrocious, as well.

New layout is HORRIBLE. I love MFP and have been using it for over 10 years. The new layout is absolutely horrible. Took away the edit button that allowed you to move foods between meals. It used to show all of your food for the day w macros for each meal. Now you can only see macros if you’re looking at that individual meal. Sure it looks cool and like another Apple product but I literally hate it. I would reverse the update if I could!!!!!!! 0 stars if I could. Bring back the old layout.
The best app. You can track all your food and free and the premium version is so good
Horrible. Do you guys conduct any ux research before making decisions? Bring back the old interface pls

Zero flexibility. They removed the quick add functionality. So if you use another tool to measure something the app doesn’t have, like a homemade marinade, you can meticulously track everything and this terrible app gives no option to log it. It’s gotten worse over the years, and I’m furious because I just paid for another year of premium when they removed the most important piece of functionality for me. I really, truly hope every single person stops using this app and switches to a competitor and every idiot responsible for this change gets fired.

Unable to use my Facebook login in app. Not sure what happened, but I am no longer able to use my Facebook login for the app. I can login through the website using Facebook. I don’t want to have to create a new login using my email or Apple account to use the app.

I would like to give this App an A but. One very highly annoying bug that they have not fixed in years is the fact that every time you update your weight, your protein, carb and fat goals completely reset. It is a complete waste of my time and makes me inclined to never update my weight.

Love the app but….. Sometimes I’m putting something in but it doesn’t match the exact calories. You should have a way of taking what is already on the app but instead, put in the calories and have the app make the adjustments for the macros based on the calories instead of using any other Measurement (at least make it an option to what already exists) i know i can put the calories in by themselves but i want to keep track of the macros as well so this would be ideal for me and i bet tons of people.

Insane Power Draw. While this app can be helpful for tracking macros, it runs terribly on my iPhone. 

It drains the battery FAST (about 5% per 2 minutes), generates a TON of heat, and all the while the app is slow and glitchy. All I’m doing is adding food to a recipe, it shouldn’t be nearly this hard. 

Uninstalling because it’s just too much of a hassle to wrestle with the performance issues.
Great app but horrible UI update. Great app but absolutely horrendous UI update!! please go back to the old version.

Goals keep changing. Every time I update my weight, my “starting weight” changes to the oldest weight in from 10 years ago, and my macros and calories goals change back to default settings. 

I’ll update my rating of the app when this is resolved.
Support is non existent. Support is non existent
Takes forever to load. It seems I’m always having to re-launch the app which takes forever. frustrating when you just want to put a snack in so that nothing is ever quick.

Clunky & Limited. Not useful unless you pay for the Premium version. Can add to your food diary, but not see what you ate for the day. Even when you pay for the Premium version it focuses on macros rather than nutrients. It saves meals, favorite foods, & weight (Premium version)…but I am Vegan and the system is quite limited in that area.
App keeps crashing everytime I try to open after putting glp1 medication in. App keeps crashing everytime I try to open after putting glp1 medication in? Very strange!

Terrible update. Used this app for years and then eventually left it for a different app. That app was no longer useful as it didn’t let me freely track my meals/food anymore. I decided to go back to MFP as it will allow this option. Well now the app is broken and completely useless. I am constantly logged out and cannot get back in, it won’t allow me to search for food unless it’s something I’ve tracked in the past and I can no longer make new meals without an error popping up. I don’t know what happened with the update that rendered the app useless but it’s really off putting. I am super frustrated every time I try to log food. Hopefully this can be fixed. I will be using a different app until this can be fixed.
Does not let you put in grams as a food measurement. Extremely unhelpful if uou are trying to be precise because you can only put in cups and other this as measurements

2026: Worst update in 10 years. BRING BACK THE OLDER VERSION. 
I have been using this app for a little over ten years. I used it for free for many years with great functions. The last a few years, I had to pay for certain functions so I was like okay they need to make that money. This year, in 2026, they launched the worst update I have seen in ten years. How does adding more buttons to log my food supposed to help make it easy!!!??! How does making it harder to see directly what I ate supposed to make it easier. Everything is hidden now and I have to find it. 

And they just added another update making it even harder in the last couple days. 
I am very close to finding another app and I’m sure that this version of this app will drive away many other consumers like me. I already saw so many people disliking this version.

I AM TIRED OF THIS UPDATE!!!!!!!! BRING IT BACK TI WHAT IT WAS !!!! HORRIBLE

Paying for premium, but not getting what I’m paying for. Very frustrating. I got premium so I could voice log entire meals and suddenly my app has started reverting to the standard version. Supposedly that was a recent fix, but it looks like the recent fix screwed my app up.
Latest Version. I hate this newest update. I wish it happened before I renewed my membership, because I would NOT have. The layout is horrible
Truly inspirational. This app keeps me focused on my goals while giving clear insights and reports on my progress. Thank you My Fitness Pal. A friend like no other 😊⭐️
Freezes up. The App constantly Freezes up. Continually have to log in again and again and again. And also takes Way too long to log into account. PLEASE FIX THIS.
Do not use. They charged me twice a month for the same subscription for months and apple is refusing to refund me. Don't use this app it's a scam.
Super glitchy. Only half of the premium features work in any way
Best app I have found. Perfect for beginners looking to start somewhere
Nice new interface. I really like the new interface. Easy to use. I like the way MyFitnessPal updates regularly to keep up with new foods

One of the longest apps I’ve used on my phone, that says something!. The latest redesign seems to be full of strange UI navigations I can’t figure out. It feels like when Microsoft Windows came out with new control panel and you tapped on things and you went back to the old Windows Vista control panel. If I myself tapping twice as much in the latest updates and I’m getting lots of accidental taps where I tap on something and while the next thing is loading, it takes a second tap and does something completely unintended. Also, there are animations at the bottom of the screen and interestingly it seems that almost every single food I log I wind up getting 100% on some macro and have balloons constantly popping up over useful information. Would love to be able to turn off animations. I liked it a lot better before the attempt to accommodate iOS 26 designs.

Ruined app. This app used to be great, but the usability is terrible. Many times it takes multiple tries to log a food item. Many times it still doesn’t work. Clearly the product team isn’t using their own app.

Please bring back food logged and calories remaining in one view. Been using this app for 8 years but am considering a switch bc of the new UI updates. It’s very inconvenient to have to log each individual meal in a separate view from the full day of calorie intake- it defeats the entire purpose of using the app. How can I accurately plan out each meal if I can’t see the calories totals in the same view? It’s really inconvenient and not intuitive at all. Also burying the goals and recipes and other features in the Account tab is super inconvenient as well. Please either update the UI again to bring views back together or allow users some way to restore the old diary view.
Enjoying the free version for now.. Ditto

No longer a useful app. This was my favorite app to record my food and my Macros on the Free app and now the whole look has changed. It is not user-friendly anymore. I will have to find something else to use that is very unfortunate

Loses Track. I’ve been tracking my food for 50 days and recently went to Vegas where it was especially hard to track my progress due to the running around and drinks and everything blending together. But, with pictures and receipts I was able to do it. Now that I’m back, I’m trying to log my dessert from last night and it’s listed my meals from Thursday on Friday pushing everything up one day. And when I go back to fix this it’s listed my lunch as dinner twice in one day and I don’t have time to waste to see if now all 50 days are screwed. I relied on this for my weight loss progress and now I will never recommend it. Thanks for 50 days wasted!

New update is a down grade and the ads are getting crazy. The old app was fantastic. The new one is finicky and constantly resetting my goals for some odd reason. It also plays audio ads anytime I enter the app with no way to turn the audio down. Still a good tool but less optimized than before.

Former Champion (Peter “Kid Chocolate” Quillin). The education at my fingertips has helped me improve my lifestyle as I prepare for retirement. MyFitnessPal has made it easier to understand nutrition, make better food choices, and stay accountable every day.

The celebration feature. I get tired of the celebration every time I log a day, get rid of it. I don’t care about my log in streak. It messes me up when I’m logging in my breakfast. I forget what I just logged because the screen skips to the confetti. Other than that, I love this app.

its changed so much and not in the good way. ive used this app for over a decade now but it has really fallen from what it once was. Scanning QR codes on food packaging to track accurate macros was once free and now costs a subscription to access. 

Logging foods in general has become cumbersome. The moment i open the app im bombarded with add and pop ups, after i clear those to log in my breakfast im shown more popups congraulating me for my streak, which makes me have to hunt for the X in the corner before i can continue my log. Scrolling through your past logs isnt user friendly either, once you add one you are taken back up to the very top and have to re-scroll down to find where you were and continue adding more foods.

I really only am keeping this app because it has years worth of my foods saved on it, but even logging those has become a chore due to the high amount of visual noise that appears on the screen. I really miss what this app used to be

Love this app!!!. I just started using this app a few weeks ago and have already lost weight. It keeps me on track and motivated. I’ve tried losing weight for a while but nothing has helped so thank you to this app!!!

If it ain’t broke don’t fix it!!. I was always an avid MFP supporter, even as other apps came about (some better) I always stuck by MFP. I tracked my 175lb weight loss over the course of 2 years with my fitness pal and it made everything easy. 

Something has changed however with this most recent update. The UI is horrible, ease of use is horrible, and everything about it has been one giant step backward. 

Just revert the design!

UI is not user-friendly. Balance Restored!

The dev team behind this awesome app have worked really hard resolving all the friction points I had with the latest UI upgrade!

1. “add more water” is now within 2-clicks, both first-time and for subsequent adds.

2. As a power-user, I can once again log items from my history without the list reorder itself mid-selection, which makes fast-adding multiple items really easy.

3. The “mark breakfast/lunch/dinner complete” banner buttons are no longer a headline distraction. (I never really used these features anyway in my typical logging routine.)

Thank you MyFitnessPal team!

New Update is Horrible. I used the app for years and would normally give it 5/5. However, the new update really changed things for me. 

You now can’t copy and paste individual items. You have to copy a whole meal over. It also takes your calories burned and instead of subtracting them from what you’ve eaten in a given day, it adds them to your daily goal amount you can eat. I know this sounds trivial but it makes things very confusing and it’s not always easy to tell how many calories you truly have remaining. 

Please change it back.
Good Tracking, NONFUNCTIONAL UI. The tracking is good, and there’s a good library. But, the UI renders it effectively unusable. Coded by a bunch of AP comp sci students in their first week of school.

App is awful after update. The app was recently updated and the changes are awful! Why fix what was not broken? The functionality is not user-friendly or intuitive and things just seem out of place now. The free features are now part of the premium package, which is just too much to justify paying per month. Sad to say that I’m moving on!
Stole my money. Was going great used it everyday upgraded to premium for the year and now i dont have access to my premium content took my $100 and support cant even get back to you.

Frequent Glitches. I’ve used this app to track my calories and lose weight steadily and safely. Now I’m using the app to simply track my weight gain as my pregnancy progresses.

It’s important for me to track my weight from my pre-pregnancy starting weight NOT what I weighed when I first started using this app. You can set your chosen starting weight in the app. However, this app frequently re-sets that to what I weighed when I first started using the app. It’s a glitch and it’s annoying and it’s happened three times in the last few months. 

Along the same lines, the app doesn’t always look the same when I open it. It’s not because it’s been re-engineered. It’s because the app is glitching and I have to reload the page that I’m trying to look at.
bruh why can’t this be completely free?. I love this fitness tracker.. it’s goated. But why tf do I have to pay?? I am unemployed!! I wanna use the ai scanner thingy 🫩

Unfortunate Update. I've been using MFP for over 10 years, and this most recent update has made the app so clunky and way less user friendly! Instead of your full day's worth of meal info in 1 page, they've now separated it out, so you literally have to click in and out of each meal to see the totals. There are just so many added unnecessary clicks and it's not intuitive. It's difficult to know what day you're on either now because it's inconspicuous at the top. ALSO, likely the worst part is the app glitches and doubles or triples the ingredients in my recipes, this happens a lot. Forcing me to edit the recipe over and over to remove these duplicated or triples ingredients. It's wild. 
Wouldn't you want the least amount of clicks? You can't even see your full day's worth of nutrition while inside a meal (breakfast, lunch, dinner) so you have to click back out to see your full day to know what wiggle room you have in your cals/macros/micros, to make your goals for the day. You have to remember those numbers as you click back out to the main screen or screenshot your meal to keep track. I'm having a hard time understanding that part of the update. Please put everything back into one page and fix the recipe duplicating glitches!

It’s Okay. My mom bought this app before I got it, and she wanted me to use this app to show what I’m eating. At a day program I go to, I’m not able to use this app, and it might be hard for me to remember what I have for lunch. (But when I get home, I’ll ask my protector if they remember what they gave me for lunch.)
Not like it used to be. I loved this app for years when it was sponsored by under armour. Now there are constant ad that are trying to force you into an upgrade.

Great, BUT. I’ve been using MyFitnessPal for about a year. I’ve adjusted to all its quirks, and I like it better than the other apps that I’ve tried. In December, I used my HSA to pay for the premium plus upgrade. I’ve been very happy with all of the features, including daily tracking for food and water. Exercise tracking, meal prep and more. However, today I had a pop-up ad. I truly believe that if people are paying for the app, they should not have to put up with pop-ups and ads. Fix this, and it’s five stars!
Wonderful. I have been logging my meals for 7 years. I’ve gone from 220 lbs down to 173 lbs.

Bring back the old app!. Great app with the largest selection of foods. I was able to track and lose 15 pounds in over a year thanks to this calorie tracking app. However, there is no reason at all this app should be draining my battery or overheating my phone (iPhone 13 pro) or draining my battery on my iPad mini. I use the app for 10 minutes trying to track my meal preps and it's burning hot and 10-15% down just like that (my battery capacity is still 97%). The app didn't used to do this 2-3 months ago. No other app, no matter how much more gpu/ram it takes does this to my phone. Also, this new layout is very annoying. I used to be able to swipe between days, compare foods per day throughout the week but now there is too much clicking/tapping. Want to see tomorrow? tap here, then here, then here. wow. I've never seen such a good app literally want people to switch to another app.
Horrible update. All logs going to tomorrow? WHY? Do you guys test updates before release?

Not syncing with Garmin Connect properly. I’ve tried all the things Google suggests, disconnecting, reconnecting, setting activity /TDEE to sedentary, etc. got a new Garmin device and the problem still stands. MFP always only accounts for only half of my active calories burned via Garmin. Switching to a new app.

Good App but Keeps Crashing. MyFitnessPal is a great app with a ton of useful features. It makes tracking meals and staying on track with fitness goals easy. The only issue I keep coming across is when I go into my saved meals under the plan section the app crashes everytime. I’m not able to review any of meals without being pushed out of the app. If this was fixed it would make the app more functional.

Massively obnoxious update. Updated: Support ignored my bug report. Calorie tracker apps are always tedious to use if you care about the integrity of your data, and this app, which has been among the better options, made it 10x worse with one tiny bug that constantly returns you to the home view after editing an entry. Just fix it already.


Original: I find the home view pointless. The app really thinks it’s useful. It’s not.

Diary view is the only view that matters 99% of the time.

Yet, any time you edit an entry you’re returned back to the home instead of back to the diary and this makes logging food, which is already a chore extremely annoying. 

Like, do you eat almost the same lunch today as you did yesterday, but had a little more bread and a little less mayo and ham? You’re going to return to that home view three times just to make a few tweaks and get on with your day.
New updates. Not a fan of the fact that I can’t highlight certain items & erase them anymore

Protein protein protein. I started using my fitness pal in college years ago and just started back and I love that I get to track my protein since I’m noticing that’s what gets me full the most. I don’t stress myself out to keep up a tracking streak instead I use to hold me accountable for what I’m eating

STOP CHANING MY STARTING WEIGHT!!!. I SET MY STARTING WEIGHT WHERE I NEEDED IT. STOP CHANGING IT!!
Also STOP CHANGING MY CALORIE GOALS. I set them WHERE I WANT THEM. I DIDN'T ASK FOR YOUR OPINION OR APPROVAL. GIVE ME MY MONEY BACK YOU THIEVES. I DIDN'T AGREE TO ANY OF THIS AI GARBAGE AND CUSTOMER "SERVICE" IS JUST AN AI BOT. PROCESS MY REFUND!!! THIS APP IS NOW TRASH.
Bring back progress circles. New update took away the macro progress circles vthat sucks. Otherwise it's the best app.
Seriously. App is great but can you stop notifying me 50 times in a day. I don’t need that many notifications. And no I’m not exaggerating
10/10 for the free version.. If your just starting out in your fitness journey, there are many other apps, but MyFitnessPal is all around the best, if you ask me.

Too many animations and pop ups. The app was good up until the new updates. It’s like they’ve tried to gamify your every click in the app. Please remove all annoying confetti animations whenever you log something and all the streak pop ups. Supposedly it goes away after a while but if you miss a day, it goes back to 1.
It’s anxiety inducing knowing something is going to pop up every day and makes you not even want to even use the app.

New Update is Terrible. Recent update really has made the app almost completely unusable. The food and cal content is now hidden, so things that you could previously see are now obscured behind clunky and useless tabs. Why fix what wasn’t broken and end up breaking it?!

warning. this app has caused me so much trouble with leaking my information, data, passwords. i’m constantly getting alerts to change passwords with my email and always links to this app! do not recommend! was even alerted on my credit Karma

Don’t mess with a good thing. I’ve been using MFP a since 2013 and this has to be the worst update I’ve seen. You’ve made the weight tracking, which I use daily, very clumsy requiring more taps just to add a new weight. It used to remember the date range that I had selected but now it’s going back and showing since start every day. I really like to focus on a few months at a time and not years and years of data. 
Not everyone is here for food logging, make the rest of the data easy to access and quick to record.
Takes forever to load. It takes soooo long. It just sits there spinning 2-3 minutes before it will open. Been this way the last several updates

Too many pop ups and to complicated. First time using it and I don’t understand it and doesn’t educate me on what to eat, what I need to eat to loose weight it feels like I log it but what does that mean? Then what so I have no clue what I should eat, how many calories and then you eat something without knowing if it’s a good choice or not

Update. Horrible update! I don't know how to use it can't find anything so get so frustrating that I give up. Since we pay so much money a year for this app, can you let us please choose if we want the old version for the new version. Otherwise I will have to cancel my subscription.
Annoying nagware affects function. If you’re going to use this app long term without paying for them to sell your data, you have to be patient. REALLY patient.
A+ Tool. A great and easy software program that provides all the data at your fingertips for weight loss.

They will lock all features behind premium eventually.. Switch to FatSecret or Lose It!, because MyFitnessPal keeps putting more and more basic and essential features behind paywalls. They recently removed quick add and put it behind premium and that was the final straw for me. Absolutely despicable and greedy company, please do not give these corpos any more patronage.
Super Helpful. I’ve had this app for about 5 minutes and it’s already showing me all sorts of recipes and recommendations on what to eat and when to do it. Amazing work creators thank you

Please bring back the MFP old version as an option. the MFP 2026 new version SUCKSSSSS! Cannot copy & paste: 1.) whole day over to another day 2.) individual foods
- hence, i have to copy a “whole meal” over to another meal, then delete foods i dont want to eat, one by one. (repeat by 4 meals i eat for the day, then repeat steps mentioned again every single day.) - pretracking meals and foods daily has become almost impossible to do with efficiency. THIS IS TOOO MUCH WORK & TOOO MUCH TIME WASTED! not necessary! having to do wayyy too many clicks, seriously. Please bring back the old version, including the edit button, the copy& paste the whole day to other days, and the copy & paste individual foods PLEASEEEE 🙏- the new version is NOTTTT user-friendly and missing the ones mentioned above for efficiency and time savers.

old ui. used to very clearly display my goal calories PLUS exercise calories but now it just lumps them all together as total calories. now I have to scroll down and look at how many exercise calories I burned and then subtract that from the new total, whereas before I didn't have to do any of that and I just saw it all at a glance. I don't know whose decision was to get rid of that, but it's very stupid.

the app itself is still fairly good besides that but respectfully please fix that idiotic decision. new and better ui is suppose to reduce cognitive load and this latest update does the opposite.

again respectfully i want to re-iterate that the decision to lump your goal calories and exercise calories together on the top of the home screen is measurably one of the stupidest parts about this update. like if i gave someone the choice between data displayed clearly into sections that u could understand at a fraction of a second or data that looks like it’s been randomly crammed together by someone with a learning disability then obviously a sane person would pick the former.

again i mean this respectfully bc i know the decision was likely made by some idiotic higher up that doesn’t even exercise but thought it was a great idea meanwhile a handful of their underlings that actually know what they’re doing were likely being ignored.

anyways hope this feedback helps! respectfully.

if this doesn’t get fixed tho ill probably just start using claude to do it. the only reason i haven’t made a ai assistant to do these things yet is bc of laziness and using MFP was the option with the least effort that yielded the most desirable results but with the latest update thats changing my opinion on that.
No way. Not paying 19 a month..

Steps. So I’ve only been on the app for a month and I actually like it. But I noticed today that it brought down my steps. Yesterday and for the past few days I’ve been hitting my 10k steps & even over that. But my Thursday says 9.k+ all of a sudden. I don’t know what that’s about …. But I know what it said yesterday. 10.7k steps.

Update 6/19/26
The app is docking my steps still. I had 13k steps and it knocked down to 12,977. I really want to know what that is about.

New update is horrible. Please listen to all of the reviews about how horrible the new update and UI is. It makes it more complex, requires more steps for everything, and is way less intuitive. I promise you, we want simplicity. As a premium member, I will not be continuing my subscription if the new UI stays. Please, please bring back the old simple layout.
BIG PROBLEM. LATEST UPDATE DOES NOT HAVE ANYWAY TO TRACK SALT, NEDED FOR BLOOD PRESSURE REGULATION. BIG PROBLEM.
Bad redesign. I hate the new look, is there a way to get the old style back??
Pay for everything!. You have to pay for the to take the pictures you have to pay for the voice you have to pay for everything. I thought it was free.

Very helpful. This is my 3rd tracker app I have used in the last 6 months and the 2nd paid one. Very quick and easy to use once you get familiar with it. "Coffee and 4 more" is not a meal log. It's a scavenger hunt. Then when you go to add items, scroll position resets every time, so what used to be a fluid multi-item logging session is now an exercise in frustration. Confetti animations and toast messages fire on every addition, as if the app thinks logging 2% milk is an achievement worth celebrating.

Good product design is invisible. It gets out of the way and lets users build habits. Instead, each update introduces new friction. Features relocated without reason, unnecessary extra taps to complete basic tasks, and visual patterns that feel lifted from a student portfolio rather than a mature consumer product. For an app with this much tenure and this much user data to draw from, the regression is remarkable.

I've given it time, because I know new patterns take adjustment. But the changes keep coming, each one compounding the last. It feels less like a product roadmap and more like unchecked A/B testing with no clear north star.

The other thing I noticed is the lack of ability to be able to manually input numbers for what I want to log. But overall, I have enjoyed using this application and plan on continuing to use it as a tool to help manage and track my nutrition and dieting goals. I plan to give another review if I see anything new that’s worth sharing or if my suggestions have been modified. 

For those who would like to use this app, I highly recommend use the Pro edition, however, if you don’t want to pay for it, I totally understand and will say the free version is just as great. But just know you will be limited to what you can do with the free edition. The scanner will not be available for use and you have be able to get any meal planing services or workout/ exercise program services for those who no need that kind of support. Outside of all that, this is a great app just for tracking and logging what you eat and your macro numbers to help meet your nutrition goals.

I have tried so many diets over the years (complex carbs with high protein, keto, etc), but nothing works as well as the gold standard: counting calories. More calories out than in=weight loss. MyFitnessPal helps to achieve that formula.

I bought premium for a year and it’s totally worth it. Prior to using this I was baffled as to why I wasn’t losing weight despite exercising and seemingly not eating much. I quickly discovered that my daily snacking on cashews and almonds was equivalent to about 600 calories alone! Unreal. I was eating a large meal worth of nuts in a given day. This was just one of many insights that has helped me so far. In two weeks I have already lost 4.5 lbs, with all other diets stalling out and not seeing near the amount of success as this.

I love that this syncs with my Apple Watch and gives me more calories as I exercise. Also love the satisfaction of completing the diary for the day and seeing what I will potentially weigh in 5 weeks if I stick to the daily caloric limit. This is super motivating.

Definitely try this app if you struggle with your weight, it’s eye opening and life changing. One word of advice: BUY A FOOD SCALE, measuring cups, and measuring spoons. Portions are EVERYTHING, and even a few grams of extra foods (nuts, butter, peanut butter, coffee creamer) can add unnecessary calories.

You’ll quickly learn that the goal is to maximize lean high protein foods and low cal high fiber foods so you stay full longer.

To the devs: one thing I would like to see is when adding an item, default breakfast/lunch/dinner to the time of day when you are adding the food. If I’m adding something at 6pm, have it default to dinner, not breakfast. Thanks!
